::: callout-note
**What this script does:** loads the donor-level pseudobulk `SingleCellExperiment` of
the human DLPFC lifespan cohort ([Synapse syn52396927](https://www.synapse.org/Synapse:syn52396927)),
in which every assay is one cell (sub)type with counts already summed per donor. All
excitatory neuron subtypes (`EN_*`) and all inhibitory neuron subtypes (`IN_*`) are
summed per donor into one EN and one IN pseudobulk; all other cell types are dropped.
For each class it records the number of cells summed per donor, keeps a reduced set of
donor metadata (renamed where needed to match the original human pipeline), removes
donors with ≤ `r params$min_cells_per_donor` cells and LINC genes, and saves one
`SingleCellExperiment` per class (`pseudobulk_sce_EN_human_extended.RDS`,
`pseudobulk_sce_IN_human_extended.RDS`) in `Human_analysis/human_extended_analysis_output/` for `02_human_extended_Analysis_pseudobulk_Level.qmd`.
:::

# Setup

```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
suppressMessages({
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(Matrix)
  library(ggplot2)
})
dir.create(params$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r load_data_human, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
x = readRDS(file.path(params$data_dir, params$input_file))
x
assayNames(x)
```

# Aggregate EN and IN subtypes

```{r subtypes_and_cell_counts, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# --- subtypes per major class ---
celltype_groups = list(
  EN = grep("^EN_", assayNames(x), value = TRUE),
  IN = grep("^IN_", assayNames(x), value = TRUE)
)
celltype_groups

# --- cells per donor x celltype (aligned by name; absent celltype -> 0) ---
n_cells_mat = t(vapply(int_colData(x)$n_cells, function(v) {
  out = setNames(numeric(length(assayNames(x))), assayNames(x))
  common = intersect(names(v), assayNames(x))
  out[common] = v[common]
  out
}, numeric(length(assayNames(x)))))
rownames(n_cells_mat) = colnames(x)
stopifnot(nrow(n_cells_mat) == ncol(x), sum(n_cells_mat) > 0)
```

```{r donor_metadata, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# --- donor metadata to keep (the original has 940 columns, mostly PRS/QC) ---
meta_cols = c("SubID", "Age", "scaled_age", "group", "Sex", "Ethnicity", "PMI", "pH",
              "Brain_bank", "Source", "pool", "prep", "Dx", "Control",
              "buildblock_controls_supercontrols_for_aging")
missing_cols = setdiff(meta_cols, colnames(colData(x)))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) warning("columns not found: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
donor_meta = as.data.frame(colData(x))[, intersect(meta_cols, colnames(colData(x))), drop = FALSE]

# same names as in the original human pipeline, so 02/03 code can be reused
donor_meta$Individual_ID = colnames(x)
donor_meta$Sample_Source = donor_meta$Brain_bank
```

```{r build_sce, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#' Build one SingleCellExperiment for a major celltype by summing its subtype pseudobulks
build_celltype_sce = function(x, celltype, subtypes, donor_meta, n_cells_mat) {
  counts = Reduce(`+`, lapply(subtypes, function(a) assay(x, a, withDimnames = TRUE)))

  meta = donor_meta
  meta$Celltype = celltype
  meta$n_cells = rowSums(n_cells_mat[, subtypes, drop = FALSE])
  meta$n_subtypes_present = rowSums(n_cells_mat[, subtypes, drop = FALSE] > 0)
  meta$lib_size = colSums(counts)

  sce = SingleCellExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = counts),
    colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(meta, check.names = FALSE),
    rowData = rowData(x)[, intersect(c("gene_id", "gene_name"), colnames(rowData(x))), drop = FALSE],
    metadata = list(source_object = params$input_file,
                    summed_subtypes = subtypes,
                    agg_pars = metadata(x)$agg_pars)
  )

  # drop donors without any cells of this celltype, and genes with zero counts in all donors
  sce = sce[, sce$n_cells > 0 & sce$lib_size > 0]
  sce = sce[rowSums(counts(sce)) > 0, ]

  # sanity check: summed counts equal the sum over subtypes (for the donors kept)
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
    sum(counts(sce)),
    sum(sapply(subtypes, function(a) sum(assay(x, a)[rownames(sce), colnames(sce)])))
  )))
  sce
}

sce_EN = build_celltype_sce(x, "EN", celltype_groups$EN, donor_meta, n_cells_mat)
sce_IN = build_celltype_sce(x, "IN", celltype_groups$IN, donor_meta, n_cells_mat)

c(EN_donors = ncol(sce_EN), IN_donors = ncol(sce_IN))
summary(sce_EN$n_cells); summary(sce_IN$n_cells)
table(sce_EN$group)
```

# Cells per donor

```{r plot_cells_per_donor, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
df_cells = rbind(
  data.frame(donor = colnames(sce_EN), Age = sce_EN$Age, celltype = "EN", n_cells = sce_EN$n_cells),
  data.frame(donor = colnames(sce_IN), Age = sce_IN$Age, celltype = "IN", n_cells = sce_IN$n_cells)
)

# distribution, with the filtering threshold
ggplot(df_cells, aes(x = n_cells, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = params$min_cells_per_donor, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ celltype, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Number of cells per donor (log10)", y = "Donors",
       title = "Distribution of cells per donor (dashed: filtering threshold)") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")

# cells per donor vs age
ggplot(df_cells, aes(x = Age, y = n_cells, colour = celltype)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = params$min_cells_per_donor, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Number of cells (log10)", colour = NULL, title = "Cells per donor vs age") +
  theme_bw()
```

# Filtering

```{r filter_sce, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#' Filter donors by cell number and remove LINC genes
filter_sce = function(sce, min_cells) {
  n_before = ncol(sce); g_before = nrow(sce)

  # donors with more than `min_cells` cells of this celltype
  sce = sce[, sce$n_cells > min_cells]

  # remove all LINC (long intergenic non-coding) genes, as in the original human pipeline
  linc = grepl("LINC", rownames(sce), ignore.case = TRUE)
  sce = sce[!linc, ]

  # genes that became all-zero after dropping donors
  sce = sce[rowSums(counts(sce)) > 0, ]

  message(sprintf("%s: donors %d -> %d | genes %d -> %d (%d LINC removed)",
                  unique(sce$Celltype), n_before, ncol(sce), g_before, nrow(sce), sum(linc)))
  sce
}

sce_EN = filter_sce(sce_EN, min_cells = params$min_cells_per_donor)
sce_IN = filter_sce(sce_IN, min_cells = params$min_cells_per_donor)

# checks
stopifnot(min(sce_EN$n_cells) > params$min_cells_per_donor,
          min(sce_IN$n_cells) > params$min_cells_per_donor,
          !any(grepl("LINC", c(rownames(sce_EN), rownames(sce_IN)), ignore.case = TRUE)))
c(EN_donors = ncol(sce_EN), IN_donors = ncol(sce_IN))
summary(sce_EN$Age); summary(sce_IN$Age)
```

# Save

```{r save_sce, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
saveRDS(sce_EN, file.path(params$output_dir, "pseudobulk_sce_EN_human_extended.RDS"))
saveRDS(sce_IN, file.path(params$output_dir, "pseudobulk_sce_IN_human_extended.RDS"))
```
